label: 🧠 Embed text (AI)
description: Add a vector column with embeddings of a text column. Calls an OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint (works with OpenAI, Cohere via compat layer, Ollama, Together, vLLM, llama.cpp). Costs API credits for paid providers; free with a local Ollama embedding model.

endpoint.label: Embeddings endpoint
endpoint.help: OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings · Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1/embeddings · Together / Groq / OpenRouter: see their docs.

model.label: Model
model.help: OpenAI: text-embedding-3-small (1536d, cheap) or text-embedding-3-large (3072d). Ollama: nomic-embed-text (768d), mxbai-embed-large (1024d). Cohere: embed-english-v3.0.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: Bearer token. Local Ollama doesn't need one. The key is sent ONLY to the configured endpoint.

batchSize.label: Batch size
batchSize.help: Texts per API call. Lower = more requests + slower; higher = fewer requests but risks 'request too large' errors. OpenAI accepts up to 2048.
